Nora (Docs): quick sync — I'm assembling a short rolling guide for short-sequence workflows (examples + tiny eval checklist + migration snips). Planning to land: examples/optimize/shortseq-rollout.md. Would love a quick gut-check.

Diego (Eng): SG. Keep it tiny. Add exact param rename map and a one-liner codemod we can paste in the PR description. Also show canonical imports used in our test harness.

Harper (ML): Please include a 3-step smoke eval: sample set (100 prompts), compute PPL delta and ROUGE-L, spot-check 10 cases. Call out that q4 variants sometimes change tokenization edge cases.

Nora (Docs): Draft snippet (py stream) — minimal: 
```python
from redwood.optimize import OptimizeClient
client = OptimizeClient()
for chunk in client.stream(model='rwkv-7b', prompt='TL;DR', micro_batch=3, kv_prefetch=True, quant_profile='q4_1'):
    print(chunk.text)
```

Diego (Eng): Test-harness note: use `require('@redwood/optimize-client')` in JS examples and `from redwood.optimize import OptimizeClient` in Py — those import paths match CI. Also add try/except wrapper in examples to avoid noisy failures in snippet-tests.

Nora (Docs): Added JS promise variant and a tiny try/catch: 
```js
const { OptimizeClient } = require('@redwood/optimize-client');
const client = new OptimizeClient();
try {
  const r = await client.generate({ model: 'rwkv-7b', prompt: 'Summarize', maxTokens: 48, microBatch: 4, kvPrefetch: true, quantProfile: 'q4_1' });
  console.log(r.text);
} catch (e) { console.error('example error', e); }
```

Harper (ML): For the quant_profile snippet, paste this YAML: 
```yaml
name: q4_1
bits: 4
per_channel: true
notes: 'Prefer A100/T4; fallback to fp16/offload on older cards'
```

Zoe (PM): Add a short rollout checklist - internal canary, telemetry flag, docs posted, product note. We'll gate large customer flip by the telemetry signals.

Nora (Docs): Adding migration quick-map: `batch_size -> micro_batch`, `prefetch_kv -> kv_prefetch`, `prefetch_cache -> kv_prefetch`. Codemod example in doc: `git grep -n "batch_size" | cut -d: -f1 | xargs sed -i.bak 's/\bbatch_size\b/micro_batch/g'` with backup advice.

Nora (Docs): CI — @ci-bot can you run snippet-tests + link-check on the draft branch?

ci-bot: running checks for PR #2141 — snippet-tests, md-lint, link-check.

ci-bot: snippet-tests failed: examples/js/shortseq-rollout.js line 2 — ModuleNotFoundError: Cannot find module '@redwood/optimize-client' in test harness.

Diego (Eng): We added an alias last month but test nodes haven't picked it up. Quick fix: switch require to `@redwood/optimize` for now and I'll follow up with infra to sync aliases.

Nora (Docs): switched to `@redwood/optimize` and added a CONTRIBUTING note about matching the harness import paths. Pushing update.

ci-bot: rerunning checks — md-lint warning long line at 52; shortened. link-check: fixed. snippet-tests: passed. All checks green. Merging. :tada:

Zoe (PM): Great. Nora please paste the final docs URL for release notes?

Nora (Docs): Published: https://docs.redwood.ai/optimize/shortseq-rollout-guide — added to release draft and internal playbook.

Harper (ML): I'll post the eval checklist and a small example eval script to eng-ml so teams can reproduce the smoke tests.

Diego (Eng): I'll ship a tiny upgrade script to tools/upgrade_params.sh and coordinate with infra for the package alias so future examples don't need changing.

Nora (Docs): Closing thread — thanks for the quick backs. If anyone spots factuals that need tightening, ping me and I'll edit. :sparkles:
